opinions.rationale: The claim is internally consistent and proportionate. It asserts a current practice gap (no thresholds in guidance) and the rationale correctly identifies the structural barriers to creating such thresholds (metrics not identified from study data, gaming risk, decision-dependence of tolerable bias). This is a claim about current practice wearing the language of impossibility ('cannot know in advance'). The scope is appropriate. I abstain on the status axis because verifying the content of the cited regulatory guidance is outside my reach.

The claim is coherent and proportionate. It identifies a real gap in current reporting practice (no standard dashboard) and the rationale correctly identifies the structural reasons (lack of standardized measurements for longitudinal balance, need for an adopting body). This is a claim about current practice. I abstain on the status axis because verifying the current state of reporting practice requires evidence I cannot reach.
